root_cause.text: The delayed workqueue (cmd_handler) is not canceled before tearing down BAR mappings and doorbells in epf_ntb_epc_cleanup, allowing the work handler to access freed resources and cause a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `disable_delayed_work_sync(&ntb->cmd_handler)` before the calls to `epf_ntb_mw_bar_clear`, `epf_ntb_db_bar_clear`, and `epf_ntb_config_sspad_bar_clear`, and the commit message states that disabling the delayed work before clearing BAR mappings and doorbells avoids running the handler after resources have been torn down. The crash trace shows a page fault in `epf_ntb_cmd_handler` after resource teardown.
